findings.note: The report says six new fixture directories, six new fixtures, six new names in ALL_CASE_NAMES and six new call sites in main(). The shipped driver carried in the bundle declares ten T-007 case names and ten T-007 call sites, and the report own Outputs table lists ten fixture directories. CHANGELOG.md states the correct total (fixture total 10). Same understatement class the report itself keeps documenting; the load-bearing artifacts are right, the prose is not.

Headline Test Result reads 306 passed / 0 failed with RED 272/23, and the regression table reads discovery 12/0. The shipped state is 361/0 and 341/4 (focused-tests and red-panel6 captures) with discovery 24/0 in regression.log. The Snapshot Notice pre-declares this and the contract plus the qg captures supersede it, so no false claim is made, but the report headline is six panel rounds out of date.

The comment says TEST-059 contributes ten assertions. Both focused-tests captures emit eleven TEST-059 lines; the round-10 addition (live Resolver family wholly applied or wholly unapplied) is the eleventh. Numeric drift of exactly the kind this comment was rewritten to stop.

The declared RED is red-panel6 (341/4), whose four failing assertions are only the round-5/6 Evidence-direct-write fix. The task-level RED (red-sh.log and red-ps1.log, 272/23) is carried in Outputs but not declared, and the sixteen assertions added after round 6 (TEST-059 eleven, leaf-symlink five) rest on mutation-proofs.log mutants A and E rather than on any RED. Substitution is sound for test-only additions and is explained in the comment, but the declaration understates the TDD evidence that actually exists.

The green-panel9 captures carry the round-12 tally (361/0) under a round-9 name. The report identifies round-numbered capture names as a guaranteed staleness hazard and renamed the mutation log for exactly that reason, then left the green captures. Inside mutation-proofs.log the uncovered-mutant parentheticals still quote 355/0 and 356/0 as the signal while the control run is 361/0.

Two shipped behaviours stay green under mutation and are disclosed as uncovered: deferral of the journal delete to the far side of the Block Evidence write, and the journal nonce to batch-directory binding. The first is the remedy for a round-9 Critical and ships with no regression test; the required fixtures (a kill hook between rollback and Evidence write, a cross-batch journal graft) are named. Neither is governed by an acceptance criterion and neither can regress without the mutation log being re-run, so this is honest disclosure rather than a coverage gap, but a Critical remedy protected only by a log entry is fragile.

The implementation has a third no-write condition while the frozen requirement still reads that the always-emitted rule excepts exactly two diagnostic ids. The repository owner ruled acceptance on 2026-08-28 and no frozen document was amended, so the ruling exists only in investigation.md and in the exception docstring. Settled by human decision and I am not re-litigating it; recording that a reader of requirements.md alone is still told a count that has a sanctioned exception.

findings.ref: staged resolve-project-context.py, _restore_to_pre and the leaf-symlink case
findings.note: When a publication target is a symlink at its leaf, the commit replaces the directory entry and the rollback writes the PRE bytes back to that entry, so the pre-transaction state is restored byte-wise but the entry is left a regular file rather than the symlink it was. The suite observes this (the assertion detail reports is_symlink false) so it is not hidden, but the residual is not stated anywhere in the contract or report.
